intro.complianceDescription: Applies data protection principles aligned with digital healthcare standards and applicable local regulations (including sensitive personal data protection requirements).
intro.commitment: AURA Eyes recognizes the importance and sensitivity of Protected Health Information (PHI). We are committed to implementing enterprise-grade security layers to protect your privacy.

classification.title: Data Classification
classification.description: We only collect data that is necessary to deliver our services:

pii.title: Personal Identification Data (PII)
pii.description: Full name, email address, phone number, profile image, and account authentication information.

phi.title: Sensitive Medical Data (PHI)
phi.description: Uploaded retinal images (DICOM/JPG/PNG), system analysis results (heatmaps, risk indicators), physician diagnostic notes, examination history, and electronic medical records (EMR) stored on the platform.

professional.title: Professional Data
professional.description: (For doctors) Medical degrees, practice certificates, and digital service collaboration agreements.

financial.title: Financial Data
financial.description: E-wallet transaction history and encrypted card/bank account information (for reconciliation and withdrawal).

usage.title: Purpose and Scope of Data Usage

coreOperations.title: Core operations:
coreOperations.description: Analyze retinal images using AI models to provide early clinical risk alerts.

medicalCoordination.title: Medical coordination:
medicalCoordination.description: Grant medical record access to specific doctors/organizations only with explicit patient consent or direct booking/request actions from the patient.

aiTraining.title: AI model training (Machine Learning):
aiTraining.description: AURA Eyes may use retinal imaging data to improve AI accuracy. Prerequisite: all data must undergo full de-identification/anonymization to remove any traceable patient identity details.

communication.title: Communication & system operations:
communication.description: Handle payments, deliver system notifications (SMS/Email), and process security OTP flows.

noCommercialization.title: No data commercialization
noCommercialization.descriptionSuffix: sell or lease users' personal or medical data to any third party for advertising purposes.

storageStandards.title: Storage standards
storageStandards.description: Data is stored on cloud infrastructure with encryption at rest and encryption in transit via SSL/TLS protocols.

dataSubjectRights.title: Data subject rights
dataSubjectRights.description: Users may access/export, request correction, or permanently delete personal/medical data from AURA Eyes by contacting support.

intro.referenceDescription: Based on applicable personal data protection standards.
intro.commitment: This document defines user rights (Data Subjects) and AURA Eyes commitments as a Data Controller and Data Processor.

rights.title: Data Subject Rights
rights.description: Users on AURA Eyes have full personal rights over their digital records, including:

access.title: Right to access and portability:
access.description: Users can view and download all identity data, transaction history, and personal medical images in machine-readable formats (e.g., JSON, PDF).

rectification.title: Right to rectification:
rectification.description: Users may self-update or request corrections for inaccurate personal information through account management interfaces.

erasure.title: Right to erasure / Right to be forgotten:
erasure.description: Users can request permanent account deletion and removal of all associated personal/medical data from AURA Eyes systems.

withdrawConsent.title: Right to withdraw consent:
withdrawConsent.description: At any time, users can revoke doctor/clinic access to records or opt out of using anonymized image data for AI training.

active.title: Active Data
active.description: Personal and medical data is maintained continuously while the user account remains active.

deleted.title: Deleted/Removed Data
deleted.description: Upon account deletion request, identity (PII) and sensitive medical (PHI) data are removed automatically: 30 days (primary DB), 90 days (backup).

legalFinancial.title: Legal & Financial Data
legalFinancial.description: Financial transaction records and terms consent evidence may be retained up to 5 years for auditing and dispute resolution.

breach.title: Data Breach Response Process
breach.description: If unauthorized system access is detected with potential data leakage risk, AURA Eyes commits to:

items.incidentResponse: Immediately activate system containment procedures (Incident Response Plan).
items.notifyAffectedUsers: Officially notify affected users via Email/SMS within 72 hours of confirmed incidents, including mitigation actions and account-protection guidance.

intro.title: Security is a core priority in AURA Eyes software architecture.
intro.description: This document details the technical and organizational controls we apply to protect infrastructure, APIs, and user data against cyber threats.

encryption.title: Data Encryption Standards
encryption.description: All data transmitted through and stored within AURA Eyes is protected by enterprise-grade encryption standards:

dataAtRest.title: Data at Rest Encryption
dataAtRest.description: Core databases (including relational user data and AI document vector stores) and file storage systems (retinal images, DICOM files) are encrypted using AES-256.

dataInTransit.title: Data in Transit Encryption
dataInTransit.description: All user-to-server and service-to-service communication is enforced over HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3.

accessControl.title: Identity and Access Management (IAM & Access Control)

rbac.title: Role-based access control (RBAC)
rbac.description: The system enforces least-privilege access. Doctors and clinic staff are granted read/write permissions only for patients they are assigned to.

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication (MFA / 2FA)
mfa.description: OTP verification (Email/SMS) is required for sensitive actions such as e-wallet withdrawals, identity updates, and bulk medical data exports.

sessionManagement.title: Session management security
sessionManagement.description: Uses short-lived JWTs with token revocation controls to reduce session hijacking risks.

certifications.label: Security certifications:
certifications.description: The platform is deployed on internationally certified cloud infrastructure with both physical and logical security controls.

waf.label: Web Application Firewall (WAF):
waf.description: Integrated WAF protection mitigates common attacks such as SQL Injection, XSS, and distributed denial-of-service (DDoS).

isolation.label: Data isolation:
isolation.description: Database architecture is isolated inside private VPC networks with no direct exposure to the public internet.

auditLogs.title: Audit logs
auditLogs.description: All CRUD activity on sensitive medical data (PHI) is captured in immutable logs including timestamps, source IP, and actor identity.

continuousMonitoring.title: 24/7 monitoring
continuousMonitoring.description: Continuous monitoring helps detect anomalous traffic early and automatically alerts platform security engineers for rapid incident response.

paymentGateway.title: Payment gateway:

tooltips.fundus: Fundus imaging captures the inner eye surface, including retina, optic disc, and macula.
tooltips.oct: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) provides cross-sectional retinal layers for structural assessment.
tooltips.macular: The macula is the central retinal area responsible for sharp and detailed vision.
tooltips.intravitreal: Intravitreal refers to treatment delivered directly into the vitreous cavity of the eye.
tooltips.avr: Arteriovenous Ratio compares retinal artery and vein calibers to assess systemic vascular risk.
tooltips.microaneurysm: Microaneurysms are tiny vascular outpouchings and an early indicator of diabetic retinopathy.
tooltips.tortuosity: Tortuosity measures vessel twisting patterns associated with hypertension and vascular disease.
tooltips.hipaa: HIPAA defines baseline safeguards for handling protected health data in healthcare workflows.
tooltips.gdpr: GDPR regulates personal data processing and reinforces transparency, consent, and user rights.
tooltips.phi: Protected Health Information (PHI) includes identifiable health records tied to an individual.
tooltips.mfa: Multi-Factor Authentication adds extra verification steps beyond passwords for account access.
tooltips.rbac: Role-Based Access Control limits data actions to approved user roles and least-privilege policies.

features.title: Advanced Screening Technology
features.description: Our platform leverages cutting-edge deep learning to provide rapid, reliable assessments of retinal health, designed for both clinical and field settings.

aiPrecision.title: AI Precision
aiPrecision.description: State-of-the-art deep learning models trained on diverse global datasets for high accuracy across different demographics.

globalAccess.title: Global Access
globalAccess.description: Lightweight architecture optimized for low-bandwidth environments, ensuring healthcare equity in underserved regions.

privacyFirst.title: Privacy First
privacyFirst.description: HIPAA compliant architecture processing data locally where possible, with ethically sourced and anonymized training data.

workflow.title: From Scan to Insight in Seconds

upload.title: 1. Upload Retinal Scan
upload.description: Securely upload fundus photography from any standard retinal camera or smartphone adapter.

analysis.title: 2. AI Analysis Processing
analysis.description: Our proprietary algorithms analyze vascular geometry, branching angles, and tortuosity instantly.

report.title: 3. Receive Risk Report
report.description: Get a comprehensive, downloadable report identifying potential markers for diabetic retinopathy or CVD.

mission.title: Our Mission: Accessibility & Ethics
mission.description: We are a non-profit organization dedicated to making early detection tools available to everyone, regardless of location or economic status.

hero.description: AURA is built on a foundation of rigorous ethics. We protect your retinal data while advancing global health equity through transparent, bias-aware technology.

pillarsSection.title: Building Trust Through Transparency
pillarsSection.description: We believe that medical AI must be built on a foundation of rigorous ethics and absolute data privacy.

privacy.title: Data Privacy First
privacy.description: Your retinal data is end-to-end encrypted and anonymized. You retain full ownership and control at every step of the diagnostic process.

ethicalAi.title: Ethical AI Design
ethicalAi.description: Our models are trained on diverse global datasets to mitigate bias and ensure equitable healthcare outcomes for all populations.

transparency.title: Total Transparency
transparency.description: AURA provides explainable results, highlighting exactly what the AI sees, while keeping humans in the loop.

journey.title: The Data Journey
journey.description: We've simplified the complex process of data handling into four clear, secure steps.

upload.title: Upload & Encryption
upload.description: Retinal images are uploaded via a secure TLS 1.3 connection. Before leaving your device, data is encrypted using AES-256 standards.

anonymization.title: Anonymization
anonymization.description: All Personal Health Information (PHI) is stripped from metadata, and the system assigns a unique randomized token.

analysis.title: AI Analysis
analysis.description: The anonymized image is processed by our Neural Network in a secure enclave with no permanent storage on inference servers.

delivery.title: Result Delivery & Deletion
delivery.description: Results are sent back to the clinician dashboard, and temporary image data is immediately wiped.

faq.title: Deep Dive: How We Mitigate Bias
faq.description: Answers to common questions about fairness in our AI models.

datasets.question: What datasets is AURA trained on?
datasets.answer: Our model is trained on over 2.5 million retinal scans from 14 distinct geographical regions to ensure broad representation.

humanLoop.question: Is there a Human in the Loop?
humanLoop.answer: Absolutely. AURA is a decision support system and the final diagnosis is always made by a qualified ophthalmologist.

edgeCases.question: How do you handle edge cases?
edgeCases.answer: We apply uncertainty quantification and route low-confidence scans to manual review for safety.

cta.title: Partner with AURA
cta.description: Join our network of ethical AI practitioners with full documentation and API access.

hero.description: AURA Eyes is built with security and compliance at its core. We maintain the highest standards to protect patient data.

certifications.title: Certification Details
certifications.description: We undergo rigorous third-party audits and maintain certifications to ensure the highest level of security and privacy protection.

security.title: Security Infrastructure
security.description: Enterprise-grade security features protecting your data at every layer.

encryption.title: End-to-End Encryption
encryption.description: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256).

mfa.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Secure access with MFA, SSO integration, and biometric options.

auditLogs.title: Comprehensive Audit Logs
auditLogs.description: Complete audit trail of all system access and data modifications.

backups.title: Automatic Backups
backups.description: Geo-redundant backups with point-in-time recovery capabilities.

rbac.title: Role-Based Access Control
rbac.description: Granular permissions with principle of least privilege.

audits.title: Recent Audits & Assessments
audits.description: We maintain a continuous audit schedule to ensure ongoing compliance and security.

pentest.details: Third-party security assessment by certified firm

cta.title: Ready to Learn More About Our Security?
cta.description: Contact our security team for detailed documentation, penetration test reports, or to schedule a security review call.
